activationClasses.explicit: The person names or directly requests a method within the accepted scope.
activationClasses.implied: Task, activity or context selects a method without expanding authority.
activationClasses.dependency: An active method calls a bounded subordinate procedure and retains its objective.
activationClasses.state-risk: A transition or effect requires a check regardless of the topic or selected method.
activationClasses.always-on-invariant: A shared obligation remains binding without loading every detailed procedure.
activationClasses.offer-only: A direct request or accepted offer is required before execution.

taskState.record: Use the existing task or project record only when tracking is needed.
rules: A returned report does not itself make the unit verified.
Verification names actual checks and preserves their limits.
A required independent check must be performed by an independent party.
Blocked or stopped work must still account for in-flight actions and workers.

services.enterWhen: A bounded unit benefits from actual independent assignments and the required worker tools are available.
services.exitWhen: Assignments are returned and reconciled, or blocked/stopped with every worker and in-flight action accounted for.

services.enterWhen: The accepted task needs an explicit executable acceptance contract and the required independent verification can actually be supplied.
services.exitWhen: The selected contract returns a verdict with evidence, or reports an unmet prerequisite or harness fault without claiming success.
requires: independent party when the contract requires independence

services.enterWhen: A phase boundary requires choosing how work continues or a concrete handoff must travel to another session or owner.
services.exitWhen: The continuation choice is made and the receiving owner has live source references, evidence limits and pending actions.
returns: source pointers when a handoff is needed
requires: the existing project record when one is used
